steps.clueRiddle: I hold your shoes and greet the sun. Stand on me and the race is begun!
steps.clueReveal: Go to the front porch. Answer three warm-up questions.
steps.funFact: Racers always read the clue out loud. It makes it official!

challenges.title: Warm-Up Questions
challenges.instructions: Three quick questions. Tap the answer you think is right.

trivia.q: Which city has a castle hotel?
trivia.funFact: The Château Frontenac looks just like a fairy-tale castle.

trivia.q: What do you say for hello in French?
How many legs are in this race?

challenges.title: Say It Out Loud
challenges.instructions: Say the phrase to a grown-up. Use your biggest voice.

steps.clueRiddle: Green below and sky above. Hunt for treasure in the grass.
steps.clueReveal: Head to the backyard and find everything on the list.
steps.funFact: Explorers always look down. That is where the best stuff hides.

challenges.title: Explorer Training
challenges.instructions: Find each thing. Tap it when you spot it.
checklist: A rock smaller than your thumb

challenges.title: Tree Census
challenges.instructions: Count every tree you can see. Type your number.

steps.clueRiddle: Two roads, one racer. Which will you choose?
steps.clueReveal: Pick Splash or Search. You only have to do one.
steps.funFact: In the real race, a Detour is always a choice between two tasks.

a.label: Splash
a.blurb: Get wet at three different sprayers.

challenges.title: Sprayer Relay
challenges.instructions: Run through three sprayers. Get soaked!

b.label: Search
b.blurb: Find five things along the riverfront.

challenges.title: Riverfront Hunt
challenges.instructions: Find all five things. Tap each one you spot.

steps.clueRiddle: Who is hungry enough for this one?
steps.clueReveal: Taste the mystery snack, then rate it on the maple leaves.
steps.funFact: A Roadblock is a task only one racer can do.

challenges.title: Mystery Snack
challenges.instructions: Take one bite. Rate it with the maple leaves.

challenges.title: Trophy Shot
challenges.instructions: Take a photo of your snack before it disappears.

steps.clueRiddle: Two laps, one clock. Go go go!
steps.clueReveal: Run around the house twice. Beat sixty seconds.
steps.funFact: Even racers need to stretch first.

challenges.title: Two Lap Dash
challenges.instructions: Start the clock. Run two laps. Stop the clock.

steps.clueRiddle: Buckle up. The road is long and the games are short.
steps.clueReveal: Play the car games while the wheels roll.

challenges.title: Road Bingo
challenges.instructions: Stamp things you spot out the window.

challenges.title: Trivia Runner
challenges.instructions: Answer as many as you can.

steps.clueReveal: Step on the mat to finish the leg.
steps.funFact: The last team to check in may be eliminated. Not you, though.
